extraction.notes: Whole report read (13 pages). Text-file page numbers are PDF page numbers. Only claims on access to employment for EU workers in Croatia were extracted (RI-FMW-001, LIM-0026). Pass 1 does not assign issues. Hosted on the Austrian Parliament document site as Council cover note 9653/15 enclosing COM(2015) 233 final. Sections 2 to 6 concern Croatian citizens moving to other Member States and were left out; the report gives no data on EU workers entering Croatia and does not assess Croatia’s reciprocal measure. Quotes keep the stray spaces of the converted text.

items.stated_text: The 2011 Act of Accession allows EU-27 Member States 1 to temporarily restrict the free access of workers from Croatia to thei r labour markets by making it subject to their national law.
items.summary: The 2011 Act of Accession lets EU-27 Member States temporarily restrict Croatian workers’ access by applying their national law.
